title: Pimeä Panimo Demo
author: velluv89
selftext:
Hello,

I'm game developer, and made a game with assistance of claude code. Used claude in programming tasks, and editor tasks through Godot AI mcp server plugin. Also tested pixellab API with bad success, even when used ready selfmade sprite sheets as reference. This means the art, and sounds is human made with aseprite, furnace, or free assets. 

Game is about running underground brewery in Finland. Brew, discover, and serve all kinds of customers. Be careful though, or you alert the LVV-agents. Get your score, and nick in to the global leaderboards.

Demo runs in browser mobile or pc. Thanks for playing have fun. 

TAGS: Simulation, Casual, Retro, Pixel Art, Funny, Finnish
